facts.fact: According to a GTM8020 statistic cited by Adwave, LinkedIn generates 80% of all B2B social media leads.
facts.quote: LinkedIn generates 80% of all B2B social media leads, and its visitor-to-lead conversion rate is 2.74%, which is 277% higher than Facebook and Twitter combined

facts.fact: According to a GTM8020 statistic cited by Adwave, LinkedIn's visitor-to-lead conversion rate is 2.74%.
facts.quote: its visitor-to-lead conversion rate is 2.74%, which is 277% higher than Facebook and Twitter combined

facts.fact: Adwave states that a small B2B team usually has less than five hours a week to spend on marketing that might turn into revenue.
facts.quote: A small B2B team usually has less than five hours a week to spend on marketing that might turn into revenue.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a practical weekly LinkedIn program can fit inside a four to five hour block and still produce measurable pipeline.
facts.quote: Done well, this can fit inside a four to five hour block and still produce measurable pipeline.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends aiming for 900 to 1,200 characters per LinkedIn post for optimal organic reach, citing CXL.
facts.quote: For optimal organic reach, structure posts with short paragraphs and aim for 900 to 1,200 characters.

facts.fact: According to 2026 data cited by Adwave from CXL, carousel posts generate 11.2x more impressions on LinkedIn.
facts.quote: Data from 2026 shows carousel posts generate 11.2x more impressions, and embedding 3+ useful links can boost performance by 236%

facts.fact: According to CXL data cited by Adwave, embedding 3+ useful links in a LinkedIn post can boost performance by 236%.
facts.quote: embedding 3+ useful links can boost performance by 236%

facts.fact: Adwave's example weekly rhythm for small B2B teams is three posts: a problem-solution post on Monday, a proof post on Wednesday, and a point-of-view post on Friday.
A third-party source cited by the page (100poundsocial) says small B2B firms can achieve high ROI by amplifying their best organic posts with a $50/day budget.
facts.quote: Small B2B firms can achieve high ROI by amplifying their best organic posts with a $50/day budget.

facts.fact: A third-party source cited by the page (100poundsocial) says small B2B campaigns should aim for a 2 to 5% CTR when targeting by job title, industry, and company size.
The page's suggested founder engagement cadence starts on Monday by reviewing a shortlist and sending a few connection requests.
facts.quote: Review your shortlist and send a few connection requests to relevant people

facts.fact: The page recommends a four-week small-budget ad testing loop in which Week 1 promotes one proven post to one audience.
facts.quote: Promote one proven post to one audience.

facts.fact: The page recommends that in Week 3 of a small-budget ad test, only one variable is adjusted at a time.
The page recommends that in Week 4 of a small-budget ad test, the advertiser either scales the winning variant or stops it.
facts.quote: Scale the winner or stop it.

facts.fact: The article advises that the monthly LinkedIn measurement scorecard should be tight enough to review in 20 minutes.
facts.quote: Keep the scorecard tight enough to review in 20 minutes.

facts.fact: The article recommends that paid LinkedIn efficiency be measured as cost per qualified meeting or opportunity rather than cost per click.
facts.quote: Cost per qualified meeting or opportunity, not just cost per click

facts.fact: The article recommends tracking lead sources in a simple spreadsheet with one row per lead source touchpoint, one owner, and one outcome.
facts.quote: I prefer one row per lead source touchpoint, one owner, and one outcome.

facts.fact: Adwave, the vendor, claims it helps small teams extend a proven LinkedIn message into affordable local TV without a traditional production process or a large media budget.
facts.quote: helps make that jump without a traditional production process or a large media budget.
